verdict.rationale: Sill is a local Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app. It documents no account and no server, and says screen and input travel only between the user's own devices. With no hosted data store, choosing a storage region or residency is not a meaningful axis for this product. This is a category mismatch, not a missing feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
